title: WIZOR autonomy gate evidence artifact
description: Per ADR-0021 D3 (порт ORIION ADR-037). Emitted by a local-only gate (live-gold crawl/probe, Docker integration, adversarial audit) that GitHub CI cannot run. Committed to the PR branch under evidence/<gate>.json. The `evidence` CI job asserts freshness (head_sha == PR head) + verdict == PASS for every gate the phase declares in evidence/manifest.json. Makes ADR-0018 live-gold un-fakeable at merge and doubles as the founder's post-hoc audit trail.

schema_version.description: Bump when the shape changes; verify_evidence.py pins this.

gate.description: Stable gate id, matches an entry in evidence/manifest.json required_gates. WIZOR gates: live_golden_crawl, live_golden_probe, docker_integration, adversarial_audit.

head_sha.description: Full 40-char SHA of the commit the gate actually ran against. MUST equal the PR head SHA at CI time, else the evidence is stale and the gate fails.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC when the gate completed.

verdict.description: PASS is the only value that lets the `evidence` CI job go green for this gate.

cost_usd.description: LLM/infra spend to produce this evidence (funded live-gold crawl/probe). Feeds the per-run budget audit (cost-budget.yaml).

runner.description: Who produced it — agent role / script name (e.g. crawler-probe-specialist, scripts/live_golden_probe.py, auditor).

details.description: Free-form gate-specific payload: crawl/probe golden pass counts, N>=5+CI uncertainty summary, reviewer/auditor verdicts + refute-by-default confirmation, integration suite summary, etc.
